lines.en: My hooves come down on fallen twigs.

lines.zh: 我的角先穿过树枝，再是我
lines.en: My antlers part the branches first, then me.

lines.zh: 我走一步，林子就响一下
lines.en: Each step and the forest answers once.

lines.zh: 我的肩比我记忆里更宽
lines.en: My shoulders are broader than I remember.

lines.zh: 我结群走，前面还有几只
lines.en: I travel in a herd; several go before me.
I graze twice, then lift my head.
Moss hangs from my antlers.
I move slow, but the weight is there.
Branches slide between my antlers.
I sink in mud, leaving deep prints.
I walk along a row of birches.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很短，不怎么动
lines.en: My tail is short and barely moves.

lines.zh: 我跨过一段倒木，蹄子很稳
lines.en: I step over a log, hooves sure.

lines.zh: 我经过一丛蕨，蕨叶分开
lines.en: I pass a fern and its fronds part.
My antlers knock down a few leaves.
I halt and listen a while.
The herd behind has caught up.

lines.zh: 我的影子在我前面的草上
lines.en: My shadow falls on the grass ahead.

lines.zh: 我站在草坡上，风从角间过
lines.en: I stand on the grassy slope, wind through my antlers.
Grass is still in my mouth.
Several of the herd stand behind me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向声音那边
lines.en: My ears turn to a sound.
I raise my head to look bigger.

lines.zh: 阳光从角的分叉里漏下来
lines.en: Sunlight leaks through my antlers' forks.
My legs feel heavy.
I lift a hoof and stamp once.
I press a bare patch in the grass.
A bird lands on my antler.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛慢慢眨了一下
lines.en: I blink my eyes slowly once.
Water sounds below the slope.
My antlers are heavy; I dip my head.

lines.zh: 我的毛在风里翻了一层
lines.en: Wind turns a layer of my coat.
A herdmate's antlers glint far off.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼的东西没什么味
lines.en: What I chew has little taste.
I stop chewing and look at you.
I am much larger than you assumed.
I lower my antlers a little.
My herd turns too.
I can smell wheat on you.
I do not move first, but I will.
My hoof stamps and the ground sounds.
My head rides above your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不认得
lines.en: I do not know what you hold.

lines.zh: 我往下低了低头，那是警告
lines.en: I dip my head once; that is a warning.
I turn my body slightly.

lines.zh: 你站得离我的角太近了
lines.en: You stand too near my antlers.
I give half a step and my legs soften.
I grunt once and paw the ground.
My shoulder throbs from the blow.

lines.zh: 我低了低头，角偏到一边
lines.en: I lower my head, antlers tilted aside.
I breathe hard, my chest heaving.
The herd draws closer to me.
I fall back among the herd.
My breathing grows rough.
My antler hits a tree and rings.
I lower my head and steady all four legs.
Wheat; I know that.
I come over, heavy-footed.
I will not snatch; open your hand.
My lips are soft; I will not bite you.
My herd crowds in behind.
I chew twice, satisfied.
Better than dry grass, this.
I finish and want more.
I stop and go so as not to scare you.
I bring my nose to your hand.
I lick my lips when done.
The herd presses me from behind.
Not enough to go round the herd.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，表示不抢
lines.en: I lower my head to show I will not snatch.
Give more and I will eat more.
Stronger than the grass on this slope.

lines.zh: 你用肩撞我，我几乎不动
lines.en: You shoulder me and I barely shift.
My antler nearly sweeps you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的肋上，被弹开
lines.en: You hit my ribs and bounce off.
I give half a step, hooves in the soil.
My body is like a wall.
We collide with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在我的肩上
lines.en: Your knee meets my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的角从你头上擦过去
lines.en: My antler passes over your head.
We burst a clump of brush apart.
My antlers nearly caught you.
You grab my coat and cannot hold.
I lower my head and push you off.

lines.zh: 她站在坡上，比我高一点
lines.en: She stands on the slope, a little taller.

lines.zh: 我们的角在空气里碰了一下
lines.en: Our antlers touch in the air.
She comes to me first, and I do not retreat.
We graze side by side.
This herd is ours together.
She nudges my shoulder with her antler.

lines.zh: 她把我角上的苔蹭掉了
lines.en: She rubs the moss off my antler.
We walk down the slope together.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸喷在我的颈上
lines.en: Her breath warms my neck.
The rest of the herd makes way.

lines.zh: 我低头，嘴够不到那么低
lines.en: I lower my head; my mouth cannot reach that low.
I nudge it with a hoof.

lines.zh: 我这副鹿角，撞回去很疼。
lines.en: These antlers hit back hard.
What fell is not important.

lines.zh: 草地上有的是，我不在意它
lines.en: There is plenty in the grass; I do not care for it.
I try to curl my lips around it.

lines.zh: 它太小了，蹄子反而碍事
lines.en: It is too small; my hooves get in the way.
I lower my head and try three times.
In the end I give up.
I push it aside with an antler.
I turn my head, antlers forward.
My forehoof paws the ground twice.
The herd steps back a little.

lines.zh: 我这副身子撞起来不好受
lines.en: This body of mine hits hard.
I do not call; I only lower my head.

lines.zh: 我的前蹄在地上刨出沟
lines.en: My forehoof cuts a groove in the soil.

lines.zh: 同伴们已经让开一条路
lines.en: The herd has already cleared a path.

lines.zh: 我把脖子低下去，角朝前
lines.en: I lower my neck, antlers forward.
I do not like being pressed to the slope.
My antler tips point at your chest.
I come forward step by step, steady.
You dodge sideways; I turn with you.
My antlers push the brush apart.
I am not fast, but you cannot avoid me.
The angle of my lowered head shifts.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，让角一直对着你
lines.en: I turn slowly, keeping the antlers on you.
My hooves sound one beat at a time.
The slope behind you is steep.

lines.zh: 我一步一步占了这块地
lines.en: Step by step I claim this ground.
I press my antlers lower.
My antler drives into your chest.
I toss my head and throw you off.
My forehoof comes down.
I charge with my whole body.
You block once and your feet slide.

lines.zh: 我的角擦过你的肩，划开了
lines.en: My antler grazes your shoulder and opens it.
My antlers sweep across.
I butt my head into your middle.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在你的脚背
lines.en: My hoof comes down on your foot.
The blow sends you back three strides.

lines.zh: 我从林线走出来，草被压弯
lines.en: I come out of the treeline and the grass bows.
My antlers spread wider than branches.
Several more follow behind me.
I take one step and leave a print.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来看这片空地
lines.en: I turn my head to read this clearing.

lines.zh: 这片草坡够我们吃很久
lines.en: This slope will feed us a long while.

lines.zh: 我从坡顶下来，蹄声很重
lines.en: I come down from the ridge, hooves heavy.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里成雾
lines.en: My breath fogs in the cold air.

lines.zh: 一只同伴在我旁边停下
lines.en: One herdmate halts beside me.
I raise my head and sniff.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿毛，我惊得跳开
lines.en: Fire singes my leg hair and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，四蹄乱蹬
lines.en: I slide down the slope, hooves flailing.

lines.zh: 水没到我的胸口，我抬头呼吸
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and I lift my head to breathe.
The blast pushes me sideways.
An arrow lodges in my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的四条腿都发麻
lines.en: That force numbs all four of my legs.

lines.zh: 草不多了，我的肋骨显出来
lines.en: Grass is scarce and my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的角上，一路下到蹄
lines.en: Lightning strikes my antlers and runs to my hooves.

lines.zh: 脚下没有草地，蹄子乱踩
lines.en: No grass underfoot; my hooves strike nothing.
